name: Olivia
description: SP9VRC's weak-signal MFSK text mode — Walsh-coded characters spread across 64-symbol blocks with the standard scrambler and Gray tones, so it decodes below audibility and sounds like wind chimes doing it. 8/250, 16/500 and 32/1000 flavors, acquiring receiver, self-test at −4 dB in-band SNR.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
